content:
maria: FYI I flipped FP8 on for the customer-A model group on H100 and L40S to validate throughput gains. Seeing intermittent tail latency spikes and 1-in-10k requests with NaN during KV-cache replay at seq_len=2048. Not on all hosts. :eyes:

kevin: Can you paste the error / a short profiler snapshot? Is this during warmup or steady-state?

maria: Here’s the clipped log from the worker that hit the NaN (stack trimmed):

```
[2026-03-17 15:04:12.342] ERROR runtime: forward failed: NaN in softmax input
model=customer-A/v2 shard=3 device=H100-0
callstack: runtime/attention.cu:274 -> kernel_fp8_attn_fused(...)
kv_replay: replay_len=1800 prefix_len=2048
tensor_stats: mean=0.12 var=7.4e-3 max=1.2e2 min=-1.1e2
CUDA error: invalid value
```

kevin: That stack points at the fused TE-attention FP8 path. Could be numeric outlier + calibration scaling mismatch. Which transformer-engine config are you using?

maria: We're using TRANSFORMER_ENGINE_FP8=1, TE_KERNEL_VARIANT=auto, QUANT_CALIBRATION=online (per-batch accum). Full config in prod: `TE_FP8_MODE=scaled, TE_CALIBRATION_WINDOW=1024, TE_FORCE_REDUCTION=none`.

shilpa: Quick theory: online calibration with a sliding window can drift when sequence length / replay patterns change (kv replay), producing a bad scale for a layer and blowing up the softmax input. The fused kernel uses smaller head accumulators and can be less forgiving than the fallback cuBLAS path.

axel: Perf data from the same cluster (after enabling FP8):
- baseline INT8 path median tok/s=1800, p99 latency=42ms
- FP8 auto-kernel median tok/s=2450 (+36%), p99 latency=65ms (tail spikes)
- on nodes that fell back to cuBLAS (INT8 fallback) median tok/s=1700 but p99=48ms
So FP8 looks great for throughput except the tail and the NaN cases.

maria: Also noticing our batching heuristics are merging short, latency-sensitive requests into large batches to hit FP8 fast paths. That reduces per-token cost but increases tail latencies for conversational flows. Example: two user messages batched -> bigger batch -> increased KV-replay overhead on prefix-heavy chats.

kevin: Two orthogonal fixes: (1) make batching heuristics aware of kv_replay/prefix_length and avoid merging high-prefix requests; (2) add a kernel-selection safety check: require stable calibration metrics before choosing fused FP8 kernel.

shilpa: I prototyped a calibration health check: compute per-layer activation clip ratio and variance drift over the calibration window. If clip_ratio > 1e-3 or variance drift > 2x, mark FP8_unstable for that layer and use INT8 fallback. Pseudocode:

```python
def fp8_health(layer_stats):
    clip_ratio = layer_stats.clipped / layer_stats.samples
    var_ratio = layer_stats.var / layer_stats.ref_var
    return clip_ratio < 1e-3 and var_ratio < 2.0
```

maria: Nice. On H100, TE auto sometimes picks a fused attention that uses half-accum and a different kernel for softmax. We need the runtime to prefer the more stable kernel on long-prefix KV paths even if it costs ~5-10% throughput.

axel: Agree. Proposal: per-model kernel policy: {preferred: fp8_fused, fallback: int8_cublas}, but override to prefer fallback when prefix_len > 1024 or when fp8_health fails. Also add a short-circuit to prevent batching of high-prefix requests into big groups.

perf-bot: perf-alert: customer-A canary run (2026-03-17) saw p99 latency increase +55% and observed 4 NaN errors per 2M requests on H100 pool. KV-heavy traffic correlated (correlation coef ~0.72).

kevin: Can we run a small synthetic with mixed seqlen (32/512/2048) and replay patterns to reproduce? If yes, we can capture TE kernel selection trace + fp8 calibration stats and iterate.

maria: I reproduced locally with stressbench. Repro recipe: 1) warmup with seq=32 for 2k steps, 2) switch to conversational workload with prefix 1800 and replay 1800, 3) enable fp8 auto. NaN appears within ~350 examples. I’ll drop the trace in the perf bucket.

shilpa: On the calibration angle: online per-batch calibration is brittle. Recommendation: use hybrid calibration: global offline per-layer scales from representative corpora + fast online micro-adjust with clamped delta. That keeps scale stable across sequence-length shifts.

maria: I'll open a small patch: (A) add fp8_health gate to kernel selector, (B) tune batching policy to avoid merging >1 high-prefix request, (C) add regression watch rule for NaNs on FP8-enabled pools. Planning canary tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: customer-A FP8-safety-patch rollout -> eng-runtime canary group at 2026-03-18T09:00Z. If NaN_rate > 1/1e6 or p99 degrades >20% revert automatically.

axel: Also please add a stressbench test that includes kv-replay + mixed batching to CI. And add a short note in the rollout doc about expected perf delta when forcing fallback on kv-heavy routes. :thumbsup: 

maria: Will do. Thanks all — will post traces + PR link once available.
